observations: Photo 0 is a composite image containing a stock photo of a fan and a photo of a product box.
The left image is a stock photo of a black 2-blade industrial standing fan on a white background.
The right image shows a retail box for an 'O.R.L.' brand fan.
Text on the box includes 'O.R.L.', '26 IN.', and 'Extra Turbo-Power Cooling'.
The seller's description lists prices for 18-inch and 26-inch models.
The image contains a watermark from a Jiji seller 'UCEEINNERMENTSTORE'.

claims.evidence: No visual evidence of an 18-inch model or box is provided.

risks.proof: A photo of the actual fan unit out of the box in a real-world setting.
A clear photo of the manufacturer's label on the motor housing.
A photo showing all parts (base, pole, motor, blades, grills) together.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual fan assembled and out of the box.
Video of the fan running to confirm motor health and noise levels.
Photo of the 18-inch model box if that is the item of interest.
Photo of the technical specification plate on the motor.
response.reason: The brand and size are clearly visible on the box. The item can be priced at its worst-case condition (non-functional) until the seller provides proof of the actual unit's condition and existence.
